native_build.evidence_rule: The authoritative native-build result is the GitHub Actions run of 'A2 v20 complete native build' at the final revision head. A run is successful only if runner steps execute, the companion and full main article build complete, diagnostics pass, and PDF hashes are recorded. A failure before runner steps is not a TeX failure and is not a successful build.
native_build.reason_run_id_is_not_embedded: This record is committed before the workflow file so that the workflow push can test the final revision head without a self-referential metadata-commit loop. The run id and conclusion are to be read from GitHub Actions for that final head.
